{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in [[The Narratorium]] during [[The Final Act Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== This map takes place few weeks after the events of [[Null & Void Event]]. The story starts off with the [[Commander]] standing in a room that contains the [[Missile APC]] and screens displaying three things, the nil rifts opening all across realms, the horrible state [[Outpost 16]] has been left in and the disappearance of the [[Dispatcher]]. During this, the [[Commander]] seemingly gets visions of the [[Dispatcher]] being held hostage by [[Lord Exo]]. He is snapped out of this by the [[Engineer]], who came in to inform him of an invite sent by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] for his show. The [[Engineer]] realizes that the [[Commander]] is not in the best shape and decides to ask him about how he has been taking care of himself, but the [[Commander]] ends up brushing all the concerns off as he thinks he is fine. He then ends up running out of the room into the hallway. He moves into a giant hangar which has multiple other towers in it, including the [[Trapper]], [[Accelerator]], [[Scout]], [[Freezer]], [[Soldier]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Mortar]]. Various vehicles like the ones from the [[Military Base]] and the like goal [[Pursuit]] skin are also there. The [[Engineer]] goes after the [[Commander]] and again tries to talk to him, this time successfully. After this, the [[Commander]] ends up taking the [[Scout]], [[Freezer]], [[Engineer]] and [[Mortar]] with him to visit the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] in hopes this would get them closer to finding the [[Dispatcher]]. The camera quickly cuts to the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]'s new theater, '''The Narratorium''', where his actors are setting up the show under his, [[Left Hand|Lefty]]'s and [[Right Hand|Righty]]'s supervision. Seeing one of his actors drop a cardboard cutout of the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], he scolds him for not trying his best, revealing that the show is set up for [[Lord Exo]] while doing so. He then quickly turns the actor into a frog. Shortly after, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] arrives to the show, which the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] finds out upon hearing the [[Commander]]'s voice, causing him to jump up. This leads to the two sides getting into a fight, with the [[Commander]] trying to get information out of the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] on the current location of the [[Dispatcher]]. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] decides that his guests need to relax, so he moves them to a seat and makes them watch his show. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] begins retelling the events of the [[Old World]], with some banter between him and the [[T.D.S. Organization]] mixed with it. He begins at the start, where two brothers, [[Lord Exo]] and [[Two X]], ruled over creation. While one wanted to give people of the [[Old World]] a peaceful place to live in, while the other wanted to create chaos. The clashing visions of the world and inability to form any compromise eventually lead to war between both brothers and their followers. During the war, [[Lord Exo]]'s small but stronger army fought with [[Two X]]'s bigger but weaker soldiers. Battles would happen all over the [[Old World]], resulting in lots of casualties and destruction. Eventually, [[Two X]] and [[Lord Exo]] would meet again and get into a fight personally. This fight between the two brothers would be felt across the entire [[Old World]], as their battle would cause pockets of unstable energy to form. Realizing that he is about to lose if nothing is done, [[Two X]] began working on a prison for [[Lord Exo]] created by sacrificing thousands of his followers. To get him in there, he caught [[Lord Exo]] off-guard by grabbing the hilt of his sword, then kept him in place. His followers eventually dragged him into the [[God Cube]]. After [[Lord Exo]] was sealed away, the battles already lasted long enough to have heavy effect on the [[Old World]], as the war ended up corrupting the entire landscape into the [[Nil Zone]]. This also had effects on the inhabitants of the [[Old World]], as the chaotic energy in it also began to corrupt everyone living there. This made [[Two X]] use what remained of his power to create Paradise, a tree which all realms come from, leaving the [[Old World]] behind. With the Paradise made, he began working on The Meta, a branching web of realms which [[Two X]] and [[Rift Walker]] maintain. All main realms are tied to it. What is now the [[Nil Zone]] would become the dumping ground for anyone and anything considered undesirable by [[Two X]] and [[Rift Walker]]. This leads to the final part of the show, which is present day, where all realms are under threat of collapse due to the freeing of [[Lord Exo]], with [[Two X]] potentially trying to stop that in Paradise. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] ends up suggesting that its unavoidable and everyone will be sent to the [[Nil Zone]], where they will get corrupted. During the whole show, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] fights against the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] and his theater crew, which consists of either people mind controlled into working for him or robotic/plush creations made by him and his hands. Eventually near the end of the show, they fight the [[Producer]] and later on also the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] himself. By the time he and his hands are defeated, the show is over and his whole theater is in ruin. [[Lord Exo]] has not appeared yet, but something else happens. His hands, which were laying on the ground, start violently shaking. Suddenly, purple smoke appears out of them, showing they have been deflated. Seeing this, the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] breaks down and begins to blame [[Lord Exo]] for this, saying he has killed [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] quickly gets over this and begins puppeteering [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]] as if nothing has happened. Realizing that [[Lord Exo]] has betrayed him, he decides to make a deal with the [[Commander]]. While the [[Engineer]] does not want him to make it, [[Left Hand|Lefty]] pushes her away, allowing the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] to whisper something into the [[Commander]]'s ear, then clearly states he will take the [[Commander]] to [[Lord Exo]] if the whispered conditions are met. The [[Commander]] ends up taking this deal. The cutscene cuts to a black screen when the [[Mortar]]'s shell hits the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]. This shortly leads back to [[Lord Exo]], who is dissatisfied with how weak the [[Dispatcher]] is as a vessel for [[The Umbra]], as she instantly died when her crown was put on her. He then goes silent hearing [[The Umbra]]'s laugh and then welcomes her back. ==Opening Cutscene== [[File:"The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
The [[Commander]] is standing by a bunch of monitors, three of them displaying nothing of value, while one displays information on the nil rifts appearing in the sky, [[Outpost 16]] being in ruin after [[Null & Void Event]] and the [[Dispatcher]]'s disappearance. He then seemingly gets visions of the [[Dispatcher]] being held hostage by [[Lord Exo]]. He is snapped out of it by the [[Engineer]], who came to inform him of an invite to the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]'s show set in a military base taken over by him. She realizes after telling him that he is not in the best shape and decides to ask him how he is feeling, but he brushes it off, eats a donut, drinks something then leaves. The [[Engineer]] follows him into a hangar which contains the [[Trapper]], [[Scout]], [[Freezer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Soldier]], [[Pyromancer]], [[Military Base]] vehicles and like goal [[Pursuit]] skins vehicles. The [[Engineer]] and [[Commander]] get into a brief fight, though it eventually ends with the [[Commander]] agreeing with the [[Engineer]]. He then recruits the [[Scout]], [[Freezer]], [[Engineer]] and [[Mortar]] to visit the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] with him. The camera then into '''The Narratorium''', where the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] is making sure the preparation for the show goes right. One of the actors drops a cardboard cutout of the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], which makes the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] mad, causing him to turn that actor into a frog. Shortly after, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] arrives. One of the actors tried to make him notice them, though this does not work and he only realizes once the [[Commander]] starts talking. He demands that the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] helps him get to the [[Dispatcher]], and later starts shooting at him after he refuses to talk. Seeing this, the [[Right Hand|Righty]] moves the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents to seats in the theater so that they can watch the show.

(Official) Tower Defense Simulator Cutscene Soundtrack - Final Act (Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - You Lost! ==Ending Cutscene== [[File:"The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] lays down on the ground with his hands, then quickly rises up into the air. The [[Scout]] tries to point a gun at him, but the [[Commander]] stops him. While this happens, the [[Mortar]] prepares to shoot. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] realizes his hands started shaking violently, then purple smoke comes out of them, revealing they have been deflated. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] breaks down and starts blaming [[Lord Exo]] for killing [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] walk up to him, and quickly after he gets over his loss and starts using his hands as if nothing has changed. He and his hands move into the air while the [[Freezer]] throws some ice into the air and then starts clapping. Afterwards, this leads to the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] mentioning how his mask hides all the pain he is experiencing, with the whole map turning darker for a few seconds afterwards. After the betrayal from [[Lord Exo]], he finally decides to help the [[Commander]] find the [[Dispatcher]], but only if they make a deal. The [[Engineer]] tries to stop this from happening, but she is unsuccessful. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] whispers something about the deal into the [[Commander]]'s ear, and the [[Commander]] takes it. The cutscene changes to black when the [[Mortar]]'s shell is finally fired, making it hit the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]. This causes for the final part of the cutscene to start, where [[Lord Exo]] talks about what he initially deems to be the [[Dispatcher]] being a weak vessel for [[The Umbra]], as she died when the crown was put on her. He quickly realizes he was wrong once she starts laughing, and he welcomes her back into the world.
